title: A Bakery for the Letters
author: Vesper Thackeray
blurb: Rafael Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must forgive the person in the mirror first before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
